background: a plain light-grey studio backdrop with a grey floor, soft natural light from the front-left, no props, barefoot
style_block: Photography, not digital art. Soft diffused natural window light from the left, warm 3200K, gentle directional falloff. Soft-edged shadows in one consistent direction, low density, no harsh contact shadows. Neutral studio white balance, natural skin tones, no orange or amber cast, subtle saturation. 85mm f/1.8 equivalent, editorial photography, soft background blur, subject in sharp focus. Vertical 4:5 composition, generous negative space at the top or side for a text overlay, subject off-centre on the rule of thirds. Mood: calm, considered, unhurried. Natural visible skin texture, no airbrushing, natural asymmetric pose with weight on one leg. Subtle realistic film grain.
negative: over-saturation, HDR artifacts, cartoonish rendering, waxy or plastic skin, extra or fused fingers, backward-bending wrists, mismatched shadow direction, visible watermark, bare midriff, crop top, sports bra as outerwear, text, logos
